info.name: Public v1.0 configuration. Identical to response_files_v0.8.1.json except that THROUGHPUT_SCALE_FACTOR is 0.8 rather than 1.0, de-rating the FUV, NUV and LSS bandpasses by 20% for public release.

N_PIXELS.description: Number of pixels along each edge of the 4k x 4k detectors

NPIX_IMG.description: Number of effective pixels in the imager photometric aperture for a 2-arcsec FWHM PSF. Sets how many pixels of dark current and read noise enter the imaging SNR.

NPIX_LSS.description: Number of effective vertical pixels in the LSS spectral extraction for a 2-arcsec FWHM PSF. Sets how many pixels of dark current and read noise enter the spectroscopic SNR, before scaling by the slit width and spectral resolution.

LSS_SLIT_THROUGHPUT.description: Fraction of a point source's flux that passes through the LSS slit, applied as a scalar multiplier on the LSS throughput. Value for a Gaussian PSF centered on the 2-arcsec slit, using the v0.8.1 ETC's 2.25-arcsec LSS PSF HPD.
LSS_SLIT_THROUGHPUT._comment: Computed by the v0.8.1 uvex-mission ETC (imaging.spectrometer_image.get_slit_throughput) with that model's 2.0-arcsec SLIT_WIDTH and 2.25-arcsec psf_lss_hpd; the full value is 0.6944392947392539. Two nearby values were considered and rejected in review of PR #63: 0.751, the same function evaluated with a 2.0-arcsec FWHM PSF, and 0.761, from the PhaseB/SlitPerformance slit_offset_test notebook, which integrates the PSF directly rather than calling get_slit_throughput.

THROUGHPUT_SCALE_FACTOR.description: Scalar multiplier applied to the FUV, NUV and LSS bandpasses (including the LSS Lyman-alpha response) after every wavelength-dependent component has been combined. 1.0 leaves the modelled throughput as-is; a value below 1.0 de-rates the whole response to cover end-to-end losses that the individual component curves do not capture.

vignetting_method.description: How the 2D vignetting map is reduced to a single scalar throughput factor applied to the bandpass. 'min' takes the minimum throughput over the field of view

nuv_filter_toggle.description: Whether to apply the standalone nuv_filter transmission on top of the NUV detector QE in the NUV bandpass

slit_xy.description: UVEX LSS slit position relative to boresight (x,y in arcsec)

im_gap_x.description: Gap between imager detectors in the X direction (mm)

im_gap_y.description: Gap between imager detectors in the Y direction (mm)

lss_gap_x.description: Gap between LSS detectors in the X direction (mm)

lss_xy1.description: Position of the LSS-short detector in the LSS plane (x,y in mm)

optics.description: JPL 24 nm MgF2 / Al mirror coating reflectivity model

fuv_detector.description: JPL 7-layer coating with a band center at 150 nm, dated 2025-05-22

nuv_filter.description: Standalone Materion NUV bandpass filter transmission, ported from v0.8.1 of uvex-mission for benchmarking; applied on top of the NUV detector QE

dichroic.description: Acton 180-nm split dichroic model with 10 mm fused silica substrate, AOI-weighted average over 20-40 degree angles of incidence

blaze.description: LSS grating blaze / first-order diffraction efficiency, ported from v0.8.1 uvex-mission (zeiss spectrometer setup)

detector.description: LSS spectrometer detector response (graded-overcoat tapered QE, detector coating and QE combined), ported from v0.8.1 uvex-mission; 'response' is the nominal curve and 'lyman' the Lyman-alpha-specific response

dispersion.description: LSS wavelength dispersion / resolution mapping (WAVE, YPOS, DISPERSION nm/pix, SLIT WIDTH, RESOLUTION), stored as a verbatim pass-through of the v0.8.1 uvex-mission file for downstream wavelength-solution use; not a multiplicative bandpass component

fuv.description: Contamination transmission losses along the FUV optical path (OTA mirrors, dichroic, detector surface) at end of life, ported from the v0.8.1 uvex-mission model: exp(-absorption_coeff * effective_thickness)

nuv.description: Contamination transmission losses along the NUV optical path (OTA mirrors, dichroic, detector surface) at end of life, ported from the v0.8.1 uvex-mission model: exp(-absorption_coeff * effective_thickness)

lss.description: Contamination transmission losses along the LSS optical path (OTA + relay mirrors, grating, detector surface) at end of life, ported from the v0.8.1 uvex-mission model: exp(-absorption_coeff * effective_thickness)

fuv.description: Fucik 2026-03-16 ray-trace vignetting map for the FUV detector, masked to the detector footprint

nuv.description: Fucik 2026-03-16 ray-trace vignetting map for the NUV detector, masked to the detector footprint

fuv.description: Dark current in units of electrons per second per pixel for the FUV detectors

nuv.description: Dark current in units of electrons per second per pixel for the NUV detectors

lss.description: Dark current in units of electrons per second per pixel for the LSS detectors

fuv.description: Read noise in units of electrons rms per pixel for the FUV detectors

nuv.description: Read noise in units of electrons rms per pixel for the NUV detectors

lss.description: Read noise in units of electrons rms per pixel for the LSS detectors
